operations.content: Soham rule: every agent gets its own keys, tokens and logins; never copy secrets between Hermes and Neocoder. Same settings both sides, separate credentials always.
Soham expects full-setup verification for every component: live test output, not claims. A green tools/list alone is not proof; run a real query/call before calling anything done.
